description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. This February 2022 campaign records spectrum measurements from CC1, CC2 and LW1 fixed nodes. The source describes continuous 24-hour measurements over one week and frequency sweeps up to 6 GHz. The nodes provide urban and rural comparisons and time-dependent spectrum occupancy. These observations support cognitive-radio studies and decisions about spectrum allocation. The measurement campaign is finite; it is not a current monitoring service. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. The linked Dryad release is registered under CC0 1.0 and is publicly accessible without charge. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Spectrum allocation and cognitive-radio planning. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
